articles.title: Australia plans capital gains tax changes affecting crypto investors: Report
articles.snippet: The Albanese government’s budget plans to replace the 50% capital gains tax discount on assets held over 12 months with a model taxing full real gains adjusted for inflation.

articles.title: 3 young DeFi apps return $100M in revenue to token holders in 30 days
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid, EdgeX and Pump.fun returned a combined $96 million to token holders in 30 days, as the crypto community shifts its focus from transaction volumes to real earnings.

articles.title: Trump Media posts $406M quarterly loss as crypto bets turn sour
articles.snippet: Trump Media’s $405.9 million net loss was driven mostly by unrealized losses on Bitcoin bought at last summer’s peak and Cronos tokens acquired through a Crypto.com deal.

articles.title: Morning Minute: The Clarity Act Markup Comes May 14
articles.snippet: The Clarity Act finally has a real markup date, while BlackRock is making its biggest tokenization push yet.
